name: Проверка по DSI Hub
description: Аудит выбранной области без изменения макета: нарушения, покрытие и usage.

audit.hostInstructions: Follow ab-audit-figma and its Proxy adapter. Rules only from pinned DSI Hub. Resolve product/platform routes and delegated patterns. Use observed component identity and native properties, never API availability alone. Plan rule-target coverage before verdicts; expand without dropping prior rows. Check paints/variable/style bindings, text ranges and configured source overrides when applicable. No unread or ambiguous rule/fact is PASS. Declare missing docs, hidden branches, uncovered families and unknown behavior. Native bridge cannot mutate. Host validates references and arithmetic, not semantic correctness of your verdict.
